title: a|b with ε-moves: two ways in, one way out
notes: This is how Thompson's construction builds a|b. ε-moves from q0 enter the a part (q1) and the b part (q3) at once, and ε-moves join them again at q5. On b, the a-branch dies and the b-branch reaches q5 through an ε-move. On ab every branch is dead after the second symbol.
ops: start q0; accept q5; q0 eps -> q1; q0 eps -> q3; q1 a -> q2; q3 b -> q4; q2 eps -> q5; q4 eps -> q5
